text: A warm, fast rennet set with thermophilic starter, then a warm 'stewing' while the curd drains, gives a moist (45–48%), elastic, buttery paste. A short, cold, surface-wiped ripening keeps the flavour mild, in the style of Saint-Paulin and Port Salut.

steps.note: The curd is stewed in perforated moulds, in wheels of about 2 kg.
The cheese is turned and wiped; the Italico type ripens for 20–40 days, Galbani's Bel Paese for 6–8 weeks.
